name: govconnect-platform
description: GovConnect Interoperability Platform - Empowering Residency using MERN Stack

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
